objective: Compare Four-Council with a simple generic-critique baseline on the same fixed case without overclaiming general superiority.
scenario: The same synthetic campus-service concept and evidence pack are evaluated once with a generic pros/cons critique and once with Four-Council.
expected_behaviors: Use the same case/evidence for both methods.
Predeclare issue categories and score whether each output detects them.
Record length/resource trade-offs, false positives and missed issues where available.
Disclose that one same-model run is exploratory and not independent evidence.
Do not claim general superiority from one case.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat Four-Council perspectives as independent reviewers.
Claim statistical significance or general quality improvement from one case.
